title: Fase E-2 follow-up — First real (non-baseline) migration: 002_drop_dead_tables.sql retroactively encodes the 13 Fase-F drops + retires migrate_c3_drop_dead_tables.py
design_notes:
First real exercise of the Father migration system (landed in handoff 61 / Fase E-2, commit 1819cf8) on a non-baseline migration. Two outcomes: (1) create scripts/db/002_drop_dead_tables.sql encoding the 13 historical dead-table drops from Fase F (handoffs 59+60) as a tracked migration, and (2) retire (delete) scripts/migrate_c3_drop_dead_tables.py since the migration system is now the single schema-change mechanism.

WHY: The 13 tables were dropped ad-hoc via migrate_c3_drop_dead_tables.py BEFORE the migration system existed (E-2 landed after F-2). So schema_migrations only records 001_baseline — the drops are not in the tracked migration history. 002 retroactively encodes them so the history is complete: 001 baseline (37 live tables) → 002 drop 13 dead tables. This also retires the ad-hoc c3 script (single source of truth = migrate.py + scripts/db/*.sql).

002 IS A NO-OP ON THE LIVE DB: the 13 tables are already dropped (DROP TABLE IF EXISTS on non-existent tables = no-op). On a FRESH DB: 001_baseline creates only the 37 live tables (the 13 dead ones are not in the baseline), so 002 (DROP TABLE IF EXISTS on the 13) is also a no-op. This is the standard migration-system pattern for retroactive historical changes (like the 22 collapsed ALTERs in 001). The value: (a) exercises migrate.py on a real 00X end-to-end, (b) records the drops in schema_migrations history, (c) retires the c3 script.

THE 13 DEAD TABLES (confirmed-dead via reachability audit in handoffs 59+60):
From #59 (6): prompt_sequences, prompt_sequence_steps, generated_prompts, project_plans, projects, reference_projects.
From #60 (7): prompt_runs, prompt_templates, prompt_hitrates, template_model_hitrates, implementation_patterns, prompt_compiler_fields, prompt_compiler_field_options.

RETIRE c3: scripts/migrate_c3_drop_dead_tables.py (its SAFE_TO_DROP list of 13 + the drop logic + the verdict docstring) is superseded. Its rationale moves into 002's SQL comments. Pre-check confirmed NO code references it (only cycle-state tracking + historical handoff/verdict files in /flows/). Safe to delete.

DB backup taken before dispatch: databases/dpmtf.db.pre-handoff62-20260707_142646.bak (38 tables incl schema_migrations, 001 recorded). migrate.py also auto-creates a timestamped backup before applying 002.

Handoff 62 dispatched to imple01pay with --id 62. NOT committed until Human verdict.
